newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends mixed, March at the low.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends mixed, March at the low.

text.p: London's nearby white sugar futures edged up slightly on Wednesday in reaction to a firmer New York but didn't have the strength to hold gains in meagre volume.
The New York spot raws contract saw renewed strength early before its expiry next week.
London December got up to $329.10 before easing to a last trade at $328.50 for a gain of just 90 cents on the day.
March advanced to $328.50 but then eased in late afternoon to fulfill trader expectations and end $1.60 down from Tuesday at $325.60 which was the day's low.

Total volume was 1,102 lots. The early firmness was also helped by some trade buying in very thin volume of only about 450 lots by mid-afternoon but it ran contrary to the chart outlook. Technical analysts were bearish of the market and said it looked weak after the sharp falls at the start of last week.
